newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Wobbly BTPs must hold 136.53.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Wobbly BTPs must hold 136.53.

text.p: September BTPs must hold above key support at 136.53 to prevent further selling pressure from leading the market lower, technical analysts said on Friday.
To the upside, they put initial resistance at 137.17 and predicted choppy trade with the market unlikely to take out its recent 138.44 high.
"After yesterday's sharp fall lower, the underlying tone in this market is soft," said Martin Scott, technical analyst at MCM YieldWatch in London.
"I think the significant thing was that we didn't break 136.53 so we may see choppy trade between there and 137.17."
